class.name: OcgTDFLabel
class.brief_description: This class provides basic operations to define a label in a data structure. A label is a feature in the feature hierarchy. A label is always connected to a Data from TDF. To a label is attached attributes containing the software components information.
class.description: ! This class provides basic operations to define ! a label in a data structure. ! A label is a feature in the feature hierarchy. A ! label is always connected to a Data from TDF. ! To a label is attached attributes containing the ! software components information. ! ! Label information: ! ! It is possible to know the tag, the father, the ! depth in the tree of the label, if the label is ! root, null or equal to another label. ! ! Comfort methods: ! Some methods useful on a label. ! ! Attributes: ! ! It is possible to get an attribute in accordance ! to an ID, or the yougest previous version of a ! current attribute.

method.name: TDF_Label
method.description: Constructs an empty label object.

method.name: Nullify
method.description: Nullifies the label.

method.name: Data
method.description: Returns the Data owning <me>.

method.name: Tag
method.description: Returns the tag of the label. This is the integer assigned randomly to a label in a data framework. This integer is used to identify this label in an entry.

method.name: Father
method.description: Returns the label father. This label may be null if the label is root.

method.name: IsNull
method.description: Returns True if the <aLabel> is null, i.e. it has not been included in the data framework.

method.name: Imported
method.description: Sets or unsets <me> and all its descendants as imported label, according to <aStatus>.

method.name: IsImported
method.description: Returns True if the <aLabel> is imported.

method.name: IsEqual
method.description: Returns True if the <aLabel> is equal to me (same LabelNode*).

method.name: IsAttribute
method.description: Returns true if <me> owns an attribute with <anID> as ID.

method.name: AddAttribute
method.description: Adds an Attribute to the current label. Raises if there is already one.

method.name: ForgetAttribute_1
method.description: Forgets an Attribute from the current label, setting its forgotten status true and its valid status false. Raises if the attribute is not in the structure.

method.name: ForgetAttribute_2
method.description: Forgets the Attribute of GUID <aguid> from the current label . If the attribute doesn't exist returns False. Otherwise returns True.

method.name: ForgetAllAttributes
method.description: Forgets all the attributes. Does it on also on the sub-labels if <clearChildren> is set to true. Of course, this method is compatible with Transaction & Delta mechanisms.

method.name: ResumeAttribute
method.description: Undo Forget action, setting its forgotten status false and its valid status true. Raises if the attribute is not in the structure.

method.name: FindAttribute_1
method.description: Finds an attribute of the current label, according to <anID>. If anAttribute is not a valid one, false is returned.

method.name: FindAttribute_2
method.description: Finds an attribute of the current label, according to <anID> and <aTransaction>. This attribute has/had to be a valid one for the given transaction index . So, this attribute is not necessary a valid one.

method.name: MayBeModified
method.description: Returns true if <me> or a DESCENDANT of <me> owns attributes not yet available in transaction 0. It means at least one of their attributes is new, modified or deleted.

method.name: AttributesModified
method.description: Returns true if <me> owns attributes not yet available in transaction 0. It means at least one attribute is new, modified or deleted.

method.name: HasAttribute
method.description: Returns true if this label has at least one attribute.

method.name: NbAttributes
method.description: Returns the number of attributes.

method.name: Depth
method.description: Returns the depth of the label in the data framework. This corresponds to the number of fathers which this label has, and is used in determining whether a label is root, null or equivalent to another label. Exceptions: Standard_NullObject if this label is null. This is because a null object can have no depth.

method.name: IsDescendant
method.description: Returns True if <me> is a descendant of <aLabel>. Attention: every label is its own descendant.

method.name: Root
method.description: Returns the root label Root of the data structure. This has a depth of 0. Exceptions: Standard_NullObject if this label is null. This is because a null object can have no depth.

method.name: HasChild
method.description: Returns true if this label has at least one child.

method.name: NbChildren
method.description: Returns the number of children.

method.name: FindChild
method.description: Finds a child label having <aTag> as tag. Creates The tag aTag identifies the label which will be the parent. If create is true and no child label is found, a new one is created. Example: //creating a label with tag 10 at Root TDF_Label lab1 = aDF->Root().FindChild(10); //creating labels 7 and 2 on label 10 TDF_Label lab2 = lab1.FindChild(7); TDF_Label lab3 = lab1.FindChild(2);

method.name: NewChild
method.description: Create a new child label of me using autoamtic delivery tags provided by TagSource.

method.name: Transaction
method.description: Returns the current transaction index.

method.name: HasLowerNode
method.description: Returns true if node address of <me> is lower than <otherLabel> one. Used to quickly sort labels (not on entry criterion).

method.name: HasGreaterNode
method.description: Returns true if node address of <me> is greater than <otherLabel> one. Used to quickly sort labels (not on entry criterion).

method.name: EntryDump
method.description: Dumps the label entry.
